evidence.quote: Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Lyon, France, SAIREM is a world leader in industrial microwave and radio frequency applications with over 5,000 machines operating in 70 countries. || SAIREM – FRANCE 82 rue Elisée Reclus 69150 Décines-Charpieu France +33 (0)4 72 01 81 60 SAIREM USA 6725-B Jimmy Carter Blvd Peachtree Corners, GA 30071 || SAIREM develops advanced solutions for industrial applications, laboratories, food industry, and plasma processes.
